description: This file defines a Java interface 'JsonViewScenario' which extends 'Scenario' and provides constants, policies, and a sample 'Thing' configuration used for testing scenarios involving JSON views and access control policies within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: JsonViewScenario
classes.description: A Java interface that extends Scenario, providing predefined policies and a sample Thing for testing JSON view scenarios in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the predefined Policy object containing various access control rules for the test scenario.

methods.name: getScenarioGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the scenario group, used for categorization.

methods.name: getApplyAlgorithmFunction
methods.description: Provides a function that determines whether the PolicyAlgorithm indicates permission on a resource or its subresources, used to simulate access control checks.
